answer: The river counter is kept in marble and vault publishes each reset. A bond is refunded only after 26 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A hostile operator therefore has to keep every alias continuously active for 26 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 4 times over for the same share of the pool. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
